text:
Ivy (PM): Quick design review for the on-prem/VPC setup wizard: how should we surface probe metadata (latency, probe type) in the host list without clutter? Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder - look at 'Probe list compact'

Rex (Eng): My vote: keep a single line host row with three columns: name, status pill, meta (e.g., 12ms • TCP). Meta should be visually muted. Expand on click for logs/commands.

Sofia (Design): Agree. Add a subtle chevron to indicate expand. For status verbs, prefer 'Reachable', "Can't reach host", 'Port closed', 'No response'. Use icons + text.

Kai (A11y): Accessibility: each row must expose role="button" when expandable and include aria-expanded. Use aria-live=polite for final summary only. Also ensure the meta text has sufficient contrast.

Ivy (PM): Copy tweak: replace 'No response' with 'No response (timeout)' in the row, shorter inside details. Also want an inline microcopy for why probes fail: 'Common causes: firewall, wrong port, host offline' with a 'Learn more' link to KB.

Rex (Eng): Technical note: if probes run concurrently results will arrive out of order. We should include 'last updated' time per row and a small spinner when a retry is active. Also cap auto-retries to avoid device flooding.

Sofia (Design): UX: show a dismissible neutral summary at top 'Checks finished — 3 reachable, 2 need attention' with amber icon when partial failures. Avoid full-page red unless user chooses 'Show failures only'.

Kai (A11y): Focus behavior: when a user expands a row via keyboard, move focus into the expanded panel first interactive element and allow ESC to collapse. Announce 'Details expanded' in an aria-live region.

ci-bot: preview build ready -> https://deploy/preview/5678

Ivy (PM): Nice. Final asks before I update mocks: consistent button verbs ('Retry probe', 'Copy command'), inline editable host label support, and copyable one-line commands in details. Anything else?

Rex (Eng): Add 'Retry all failed' behind a dropdown with confirmation and show cooldown tooltip.

Sofia (Design): I'll update the figma with compact rows + expandable details + neutral banner + copy changes. Will post updated preview link when done.
